"""Deep-tree exactness: mode-0-only instances (huge spread) up to R=9 vs brute force."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import planner, ref

def layout_cost(nodes, R, starts, q, bursts, hit, miss, decode):
    """Independent recomputation of (work, pages, resident) for a BFS layout."""
    qsum=[0]*(R+1)
    for i in range(R): qsum[i+1]=qsum[i]+q[i]
    def T(lo,hi):
        t=0
        for w,runs in bursts:
            if any(lo<=r<hi for r in runs): t+=w
        return t
    work=0; pages=1+ref._pages(4*R); resident=0
    for kind,mode,cached,lo,span,kids in nodes:
        if kind:
            assert 1<=span<=8 and not kids, nodes
            p=ref._pages(32+span*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=span
        else:
            assert 2<=len(kids)<=9
            assert span==sum(nodes[c][4] for c in kids), (span,[nodes[c][4] for c in kids])
            assert lo==nodes[kids[0]][3]
            p=ref._pages(32+4*len(kids)+(len(kids)-1)*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=len(kids)-1
        b=(keys+ref.LANES[mode]-1)//ref.LANES[mode]+decode[mode]
        t=T(lo,lo+span)
        work += p*(hit if cached else miss)*t + b*(qsum[lo+span]-qsum[lo])
        pages += p
        if cached: resident += p
    assert nodes[0][3]==0 and nodes[0][4]==R
    return work, pages, resident

def main():
    seed=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1
    rounds=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 6
    Rmax=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 8
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    bad=0
    for it in range(rounds):
        R=rng.randrange(7,Rmax+1)
        # huge spread -> only mode 0 legal everywhere
        starts=[0]+sorted({rng.randrange(1<<70,1<<128) for _ in range(R-1)})
        q=[rng.randrange(0,30) for _ in range(R)]
        bursts=[(rng.randrange(1,20), sorted({rng.randrange(R) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,4))}))
                for _ in range(rng.randrange(0,4))]
        cap=rng.randrange(0,4); hit=rng.randrange(1,8); miss=rng.randrange(hit,30)
        decode=[rng.randrange(0,4) for _ in range(3)]
        lo,io=planner.option_tables(decode)
        t=time.time()
        plans=planner.plan_version(R,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode,lo,io)
        dt1=time.time()-t
        t=time.time()
        gold=ref.brute_frontier(R,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode)
        dt2=time.time()-t
        mine=[(p.work,p.pages+1+ref._pages(4*R)) for p in plans]
        if mine!=gold:
            bad+=1
            print("MISMATCH R=%d cap=%d hit=%d miss=%d dec=%s"%(R,cap,hit,miss,decode))
            print(" q",q); print(" bursts",bursts)
            print(" mine",mine); print(" gold",gold)
            for c,(m,g) in enumerate(zip(mine,gold)):
                if m!=g: print("  c=%d mine %s gold %s"%(c,m,g))
            break
        for p,plan in enumerate(plans):
            w,pg,res=layout_cost(plan.nodes,R,starts,q,bursts,hit,miss,decode)
            assert w==plan.work and pg==plan.pages and res<=p, (w,plan.work,pg,plan.pages,res,p)
        print("R=%d cap=%d ok  plan %.2fs brute %.2fs"%(R,cap,dt1,dt2))
    print("rounds",rounds,"bad",bad)
main()
PYEOF
